headline: "Honey, you haven't sold Samsung and SK Hynix yet, have you?"… Record shareholder returns of 300 trillion won, debt-financed stock purchases also rise [Investment 360]
summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix announced shareholder return policies totalling about 300 trillion won despite record earnings. Debt-financed share purchases also rose.
why: Samsung and SK Hynix are the leading memory chip makers and their capital return policies shape investor sentiment in Korean equities.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Large shareholder returns are generally supportive for shareholders.
